🏎️Welcome to Blow up Lucky Blocks For Cars!🏎️ 

👍Like the game and join the group for a FREE Car!

How to Play:
💥Blow up Blocks to get Cars!
💸Place your Cars and earn cash!
⚔️Buy new Launchers to Blow up faster!
🚀Expand your base and get RICH!
💎Unbox rare cars and complete the index!
🌟Show off and flex your car collection!

🚨More updates are coming soon!
